parameters.formDescription:
Choose a data source and click Submit to run the weekly pulse analysis.

📋 If uploading a custom CSV, it must have these 4 columns:
  • rating  — number 1–5
  • title   — short review headline (can be blank)
  • text    — full review text
  • date    — in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-02-15)
Dates must fall within the last 8 weeks. Max 100 rows processed.

options.responseText: Thanks! Your analysis is running — check your inbox in ~10 minutes.
